_comment: Read by tools/make_manifest.py. An env listed under exclude_from_builds is left out of that channel's OTA manifest builds{}, so boards of that chip get no automatic update (PROTOCOL.md section 11.5; firmware and v0.3.x clients alike treat a missing entry as no update - test/test_legacy_manifest_select). Its images are still copied to --dist for manual flashing. Remove an env from the list only after a real board of that chip passed the release's journeys.

prod.reason: no automatic OTA to ESP32-S3 or ESP8266 until a real board of that chip passes (iv1 R-S3 / R-8266)
